MK_ISOMETRIC_BOARD.isometricBoard.title: Isometric Encounter Board
MK_ISOMETRIC_BOARD.isometricBoard.toggle: Toggle Isometric Encounter Board for this Scene
MK_ISOMETRIC_BOARD.isometricBoard.panelD: Drag this header to move the settings panel, or focus it and use the arrow keys. Shift moves farther.
MK_ISOMETRIC_BOARD.isometricBoard.gridEd: Drag the grid to move it, its gold corners to resize, or the circular-arrow handle above the frame to rotate. Click Done or press Escape to finish.
MK_ISOMETRIC_BOARD.isometricBoard.gridSh: Choose a diamond grid or a trapezoid grid with a shorter top edge and a wider bottom edge. Saved on the Scene for everyone. Tokens stay in place.
MK_ISOMETRIC_BOARD.isometricBoard.topWid: Set the trapezoid's top edge to 20–90% of its bottom edge. Smaller values make the grid narrow more toward the top. Saved on the Scene for everyone.
MK_ISOMETRIC_BOARD.isometricBoard.boardS: The GM chooses 6–18 spaces per side. Fewer spaces make larger tiles. Move Grid adjusts the board's position; drag its corner handles to resize without changing the square count. Saved on the Scene for everyone.
MK_ISOMETRIC_BOARD.isometricBoard.moveGr: Drag the map to move the grid, a gold frame corner to resize, or the circular-arrow handle above the frame to rotate around the grid's center. The opposite frame corner stays fixed while resizing. The square count and 5-ft distances stay unchanged. Release to save for everyone; tokens stay in place. Click Done to finish; Escape cancels an unfinished drag and exits.
MK_ISOMETRIC_BOARD.isometricBoard.gridCo: The GM chooses the grid-line color for this Scene. Preview changes live, then save when the color picker finishes. Range highlights keep their own colors.
MK_ISOMETRIC_BOARD.isometricBoard.tiltHi: Set the grid angle from 5–85 degrees before width/height sizing and rotation. Lower values make a flatter grid. The board keeps its saved size and position; manual angles may leave margins.
MK_ISOMETRIC_BOARD.isometricBoard.rotati: Rotate the board on the map from -180 to 180 degrees. Token artwork keeps its own orientation. Shared with everyone viewing this Scene.
MK_ISOMETRIC_BOARD.isometricBoard.fitSce: Reset the board's size and position, restore automatic tilt and zero rotation, and fit the selected shape to the Scene width and height. The grid shape, top width, and square count stay unchanged.
MK_ISOMETRIC_BOARD.isometricBoard.opacit: Adjust the grid, range highlights, and movement preview from 0–100%. Saved on this client. The subtle default is 20%; at 0% the board is invisible and its controls remain available.
MK_ISOMETRIC_BOARD.isometricBoard.select: Select exactly one token you own to use Board Move.
Select one scene token to show movement and engagement ranges.
MK_ISOMETRIC_BOARD.isometricBoard.outsid: {name} is outside the board. Drag it onto a board space.
MK_ISOMETRIC_BOARD.isometricBoard.moveHi: Click a space to move · Escape exits
MK_ISOMETRIC_BOARD.isometricBoard.farLeg: Beyond 30 ft · line of sight still applies
MK_ISOMETRIC_BOARD.isometricBoard.occupi: Another token occupies that board space.
MK_ISOMETRIC_BOARD.isometricBoard.footpr: The token's entire base must fit inside the board.
MK_ISOMETRIC_BOARD.isometricBoard.resize: That grid size would overlap token bases or leave part of a base outside the board. Reposition the tokens before changing the grid size.
MK_ISOMETRIC_BOARD.isometricBoard.viewOc: Those board parameters would overlap token bases or leave a base partly outside the board. Reposition the tokens or choose another view.
MK_ISOMETRIC_BOARD.isometricBoard.error: Isometric Board could not complete that action. See the browser console for details.
